mapper.insert: insert into corgi_fake_user_pool (`user_id`) select f.user_id from corgi_user_follow f join corgi_user_position p on p.user_id = f.follow_user_id join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = f.follow_user_id where p.uptime < #{time} group by f.follow_user_id order by count(1) desc limit #{size}
insert ignore into corgi_user_follow (`user_id`, `follow_user_id`, `uptime`, `type`) values ( #{userId}, #{followId}, NOW(), 'fake' );
